description: Election Commission - Mr. B. K. A. K. Rudrigu of the Nikaweratiya Pradeshiya Sabha has Vacated his Office of the member of that Padeshiya Sabha - Mr. M. M. Niyas of the Nikaweratiya Pradeshiya Sabha has Vacated his Office of the member of the Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette contains notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that two members of the Nikaweratiya Pradeshiya Sabha have vacated their offices due to ceasing membership in a political party. This content directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials in local government, fitting the definition of Elections Gazettes (Type 7) which cover electoral matters including vacating of offices.
